verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents managed LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators that automatically score live production traces via evaluator rules ("Evaluate Production Traffic"). Its engineering guides describe running the same evaluator offline with `run_experiment` and continuously on a sample of live traffic. A community comment says LLM-as-judge may not be included in the free/self-hosted tier; that is an availability caveat, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of online evaluation, explicit evidence that code/deterministic evaluators also run on live traffic, and clarity on tier availability for self-hosted users.
